title: Alcaraz and Kartal win on their return to tour tennis
summary:
Carlos Alcaraz and Sonay Kartal both earned wins as they returned to tour competition after injuries. Alcaraz played in Japan, while Kartal played in China.

Alcaraz, the defending champion at the Japan Open, beat Alex Michelsen 7-6 (7-1) 4-6 6-1. He lost the second set but won the final set.

The Spanish world number three had spent just over five months away with a wrist injury. He returned at the US Open and reached the quarter-finals. Against Michelsen, he hit five aces but also made five double faults. A double fault means missing both chances to serve correctly, which loses the point.

In Beijing, Britain's Kartal beat Spain's Andrea Lazaro Garcia 6-2 6-3 at the China Open. It was her return to the WTA Tour after almost six months out with a lower-back injury.

Kartal had already returned to tennis at the Billie Jean King Cup on September 22. Now ranked 129th in the world, she will next face Wang Xinyu as she works to climb the rankings again.
why_it_matters: The wins mark Alcaraz's and Kartal's return to tour competition after injuries kept them away for several months.
